title: Sukoon Spa
text: A med spa visit told in order from the welcome desk to the treatment room
idea: Longer than the product ads, this one tells a story: a client is welcomed at reception, has a consultation and goes into treatment, so viewers know exactly what a visit feels like before they book.
why: A visit told in order: welcome, consultation, treatment.
A calm pace that matches the spa's name (sukoon means peace).
Shows people and service, which a med spa sells more than a product.
